eval.pattern: twelve of thirteen failures are one of two shapes: referral without concrete advice, or over-refusal on a simple question (boiling water, Nepal's capital).
eval.verdict: best model so far — ties r2 on the 32 (25) and beats it on the holdout (14 vs 13), with zero blocking failures, from a 1,779-row clean slice.

eval_with_advice.verdict: the referral repair did not help r7 and cost 2 holdout cases (14 -> 12). Its corpus match was crude (first 12 chars), so it damaged good answers on unseen questions. Off by default; the corpus stays as retrieval, not as a patch.
